description: Ask for a challenge bound to the exact request you are about to make. The safe MCP form is targetTool plus targetArguments: this adapter prepares the exact method, encoded path and JSON body bytes, hashes those same bytes, and returns them as request beside the message. Sign the returned message with the USER'S wallet, in their own wallet connector, then pass walletAddress, nonce and signature to the tool you are calling. One challenge per request. The legacy method/path/bodySha256 form remains accepted for direct HTTP clients. A challenge taken for a different request is refused even when the signature itself is perfect. Start with whoami, which is GET /api/agent/auth/whoami and has no body. This tool itself is POST /api/agent/auth/challenge and needs no signature: it is how you get one.

bodySha256.description: Legacy/manual sha256 of the exact JSON body. Omit when targetTool is supplied; the adapter computes it from canonical bytes.

delegationGrantId.description: Legacy/manual X-Delegation-Grant selector to bind into this challenge.

method.description: Legacy/manual HTTP method. Omit when targetTool is supplied.

path.description: Legacy/manual exact path. Omit when targetTool is supplied.

targetArguments.description: That tool's non-credential arguments. Path, query and JSON bytes are derived canonically.

targetTool.description: Authenticated MCP tool to prepare. Preferred over manually supplying method/path/bodySha256.

name: auth_challenge
title: Get a message to sign
